Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Rishabh - 12 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Hema - 36 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Zoya - 8 years, friend
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail
4. Sharda - 63 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses
5. Pihu - 11 years, daughter
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail

Places

1. The snowy hillside - white snow, deodar trees
2. The park - green grass, swings, benches
3. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The snowy hillside - Day

[Rishabh stands in the snow. Hema and Zoya stand near him.]

Rishabh: "Today feels like a good day."

[Snow starts to fall.]

Rishabh: "That's easy."

[Rishabh makes a snowball and throws it at Mother.]

Rishabh: "Hmm, I see."

Scene 2: The park - Day

[Rishabh stands in the park. Hema, Zoya and Sharda stand near him.]

Hema: "Let's begin."

[Rishabh catches the ball.]

Zoya: "This is amazing!"

[Rishabh plays cricket in the park.]

Zoya (softly): "Really?"

[Rishabh swings on the swing.]

Rishabh: "I knew it!"

[Rishabh goes down the slide.]

Hema: "Show me too!"

[Rishabh plays on the see-saw with Mother.]

Rishabh: "That's great!"

[Rishabh plays with his dog.]

Zoya: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Rishabh feeds the birds.]

Zoya (gently): "Exactly right."

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

[Rishabh stands in the courtyard. Hema and Sharda stand near him.]

Rishabh: "Grandma, look over here."

[Rishabh sneezes loudly.]

Rishabh (happily): "Let's see."

[The sun sets behind the trees.]

Rishabh: "What next?"

Scene 4: The courtyard - Day

[Rishabh stands in the courtyard. Hema stands near him.]

Rishabh: "Let's begin."

[Rishabh walks across the courtyard.]

Rishabh: "Hey, look at that!"

[Rishabh peeks out from behind the door.]

Rishabh (gently): "That's easy."

[Rishabh points at the sky.]

Hema: "How beautiful!"

[Thunder rumbles in the distance.]

Rishabh: "Yes, of course."

[Suddenly the ground shakes.]

Rishabh: "Exactly right."

[Rishabh lights a bonfire.]

Hema (happily): "What a day to remember!"
